purpose: Teach: 添削/並列/倍率/増資/商取引/仮称/用具/インプット

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内文書の添削をシステム化しましょう
lines.en: Let's systematize how we handle in-house document editing.
lines.style: Efficient, no-nonsense opening. Clear authority. Brisk pace, slightly forward-leaning energy. Like someone who has already thought this through and is moving the meeting forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。複数案を並列に検討しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently looking at multiple proposals in parallel.
lines.style: Measured, competent. The tone of someone reporting on work already underway. Steady eye contact. Not eager to please, just reliable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 応募倍率を業界平均と比べましょう
lines.en: Let's compare our application-to-acceptance ratio against the industry average.
lines.style: Crisp directive. Slight pause before the instruction — letting it land. Expectation of follow-through, but not unkind. Business-standard pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。増資のお知らせは投資家にも届けます
lines.en: Yes. We'll also make sure the capital increase announcement reaches our investors.
lines.style: Steady report. The quality of someone ticking off completed items on a mental list. Calm, unrushed. Slightly forward-looking inflection on the second half.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 国際商取引のルールを再確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the rules around international trade agreements once more.
lines.style: Deliberate, careful. The pace of someone who knows precision matters here. Almost gentle insistence on thoroughness, not sharp demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗の仮称を社内、共有しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already shared the tentative name for the new store with the team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact completion report. Quick pace, slight satisfaction underneath — work already done. No need to linger; moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内の用具棚を整理しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the equipment shelves organized.
lines.style: Simple, direct instruction. Almost casual — this is a small thing but it matters. Even pace, no drama. The energy of someone who cleans as they go.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の声をインプットとして活かします
lines.en: Yes. We'll use customer feedback as input for improvement going forward.
lines.style: Closing statement — slightly warmer than the updates. A small shift into longer-term thinking. Calm, thoughtful. The final note that ties the meeting forward.
